get.description: Retrieves the number of tickets that are in the 'on hold' status.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Starting date for defining custom time range

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Ending date for defining custom time range

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Predefined time range from which the stats must be fetched

parameters.name: agentId
parameters.description: ID(s) of the agent(s) whose stats must be fetched

parameters.name: departmentId
parameters.description: ID(s) of the department(s) from which the stats must be fetched

parameters.name: teamId
parameters.description: ID(s) of the team(s) from which the stats must be fetched

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Channel through which the tickets were received

parameters.name: groupBy
parameters.description: Key that groups the ticket count according to a particular attribute<br><strong>Possible values:</strong> date, channel, agent, hour
